operator.key_normalization: runner performs no normalization; generated active test vectors are represented unit keys and reader verifies their norm
operator.input_storage: FP32 values; future native run must bind immutable stored inputs
operator.exceptional_values: bounded finite values; NaN/Inf outside contract
operator.padding: steps at or above each sequence length do not update state or write outputs

variants.description: One separate kernel launch per token; each CTA owns one sequence and each state-row lane reads/writes its FP32 row each step.
One fused sequence launch; each state-row lane keeps its full d_k row live and stores final state once, subject to compiler register allocation/spills.

candidate_measurements.purpose: single-token latency with independent states; no future tokens batched
short sequence setup/launch and state movement
register retention, spills/residency, and complete state traffic

comparison_requirements: same immutable keys, values, queries, gates, lengths, and nonzero initial state for both variants
per_token timing includes all per-token launches; record host enqueue, host completion, and CUDA-event interval separately
CUDA event interval may contain device idle time caused by host submission gaps
do not attribute whole-operator timing differences to state traffic alone
all live outputs and every final state element compared to independent FP64 reference
full sequence and segmented carry around available boundaries must both pass
normal controller-admitted timing only; complete operator path
report source-level state reads/writes separately from measured DRAM traffic
include decode, short prefill, and long prefill in one bounded immutable bundle
no chunk candidate unless an equivalent derivation and real caller input availability are established

bundle.representation: FP32 inputs and initial states plus FP64 outputs/final states in one versioned little-endian bundle
bundle.padding: NaN sentinels in all padded inputs and FP64 output references; native outputs initialized to finite sentinel

numeric_policy.applies_to: every live output and every final-state element
numeric_policy.cpu_fp32_probe: fp32_policy_probe.json; CPU-only and non-CUDA; all probed values within fixed tolerance

cpu_checks.python: 13 unittest tests across recurrence oracle and bundle roundtrip/corruption tests
cpu_checks.cpp: test_bundle_reader.cpp built with host g++ only and run against recurrence_inputs.bin
cpu_checks.fp32_probe: fp32_policy_probe.json; CPU-only FP32 FMA-order sanity probe, not CUDA evidence
cpu_checks.native_runner: draft only; no CUDA compilation or GPU execution
